_note: Thermocouple: two wires of different metals joined at a hot junction (the bead at the top); the free ends are the cold junction at bench temperature. 2-terminal: pos, neg (for a hot junction hotter than the bench, pos is positive). Engine (bw-board thermocouple): Seebeck EMF E(hotC) - E(coldC) from the ITS-90 reference table of its type (K chromel/alumel ~41 uV/K, T copper/constantan ~40-60 uV/K, J, E) in series with ohms (5). hotC is the learner's flame/heat control; coldC defaults to the bench temperature.
